cmd:
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN= /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
D=/opt/trading-bot/classic
for f in classic_strategy classic_pos_html classic_panel classic_trendline classic_hand; do cp $D/$f.py $D/$f.py.bak_before_prune 2>/dev/null; curl -sfH "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/$f.py" -o $D/$f.py; done
curl -sfH "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/smoke14.py" -o /tmp/smoke14.py
chown -R tbot:tbot $D
for f in classic_strategy classic_pos_html classic_panel classic_trendline classic_hand; do /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python -m py_compile $D/$f.py && echo COMPILED $f; done
systemctl restart classicbot; sleep 10; systemctl is-active classicbot
echo -n "список: Пересечение EMA20 и EMA200 / Пробой канала робота / устар.: "; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8091/ | grep -c "Пробой канала, флэта или треугольника, построенного роботом"
echo -n "панель 18093 отвечает: "; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:18093/
echo -n "hand.json: "; ls -la $D/hand.json 2>&1 | head -1
sudo -u tbot /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python /tmp/smoke14.py 2>&1 | tail -n 9
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8091/api/runs | /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python -c "
import json,sys
for r in json.load(sys.stdin)[\"runs\"]: print(\"прогон\", r[\"id\"], r[\"name\"][:40], r[\"stats\"][\"n\"], \"сделок, net\", r[\"stats\"][\"net\"], r[\"stats\"].get(\"money\",{}).get(\"profit\"))"
